name: comp-543
title: Avatar Image Uploader
blurb: Avatar uploader with drag-and-drop support and dragging visual feedback.
description: Circular avatar upload button that accepts click or drag-drop. Shows hover/dragging state and displays preview when image is loaded.
use_when: Profile or team member avatars with intuitive drag-and-drop.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices where drag-and-drop gestures are unclear.
a11y: Button has aria-label. Drop area responds to drag events. Input sr-only.
